clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says to flip your vitamin bottle over before swallowing another pill.

His first check: dyes. If the label lists a red or blue dye, he says to put it back - some of the best-selling brands still use it just to make the pill look better.

His second check: steric acid and magnesium stearate, added only to help pills slide through the factory machines faster. His own test - take a spoonful on its own and notice how your body reacts.

His rule: see either ingredient on the label, and don't buy from that company again.

#kevintrudeau #supplements #wbdaily #readthelabel #healthtruth #supplementfacts

Kevin Trudeau says to ask who actually owns your vitamin company before you trust the label.

His claim: the world's biggest seller of vitamins and minerals isn't a health company at all - it was built by two soap salesmen. They sold cleaning products door to door through multi-level marketing, then years later bought out the whole-food supplement company they once represented.

Kevin's point: the founders of the biggest name in the industry were business people first, not health people. Their goal was building an enterprise and a profit, not the best possible product.

Before you trust a label, his question is simple: who's really running the company behind it?

#kevintrudeau #supplements #wbdaily #vitamins #healthtruth #readthelabel

clips.end_words: That's what the body is designed.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says the body was never built to get the exact same nutrients from the exact same source every single day.

His example: you don't eat the same meal for breakfast, lunch and dinner all week - you rotate your vegetables, your proteins, your starches. His point: a supplement should work the same way.

Kevin's own rule - never the same combination of whole-food ingredients two days running, over a full month-long cycle.

If your multivitamin is the exact same pill every single morning, his question is simple: when does your body ever get a break from it?

#kevintrudeau #supplements #wbdaily #wholefoods #healthtruth #readthelabel
